## What about battery longevity?

This is an important distinction when comparing against the S2000 Pro.

The [Paravolta best-generator index](https://paravolta.com/best/solar-generator/) lists the S2000 Pro with **2,500+ cycles to 80% capacity** and ternary lithium (NMC) chemistry.

The [Best Batteries comparison](https://en.best-batteries.com/power-stations/allpowers-s2000-pro/) lists the ALLPOWERS R2500 and R1500 LITE as LiFePO4 alternatives. If you expect to charge and discharge your power station frequently, LiFePO4 is worth prioritizing.

## My final recommendation

- **Best upgrade without going overboard:** BLUETTI AC200L
- **Best for powering demanding appliances:** EcoFlow DELTA 3 Max Plus
- **Best value for substantially more capacity:** Pecron E3600LFP
- **Best for frequent travel:** Jackery Explorer 2000 v2
- **Best premium, high-capacity alternative:** Anker SOLIX F3000

One important caveat: your sources compare both standalone power stations and complete solar generator kits. Make sure the price includes solar panels if you want a ready-to-use kit comparable to the ALLPOWERS S2000 Pro solar generator kit.
